components.name: Button
components.description: Enamel button with an ink border and Gill Sans lettering; inverts when pressed, hatched when disabled.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 2px solid #17211d; border-radius: 6px; background: #eef0ea; color: #17211d; font: 600 16px 'Gill Sans', 'Gill Sans MT', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #f7f8f4; } .ds-btn:active:not(:disabled) { background: #17211d; color: #eef0ea; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:disabled { color: #7d8782; border-color: #c5cbc3; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(23,33,29,.08) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px), #dfe3dc; cursor: default; }

components.name: Go button
components.description: The one signal red action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-go { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 30px; border: 2px solid #c62f2a; border-radius: 6px; background: #c62f2a; color: #fff; font: 600 20px 'Gill Sans', 'Gill Sans MT', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-go:hover { background: #b22a25; } .ds-go:active { background: #a32521; border-color: #a32521; }

components.name: Nameboard
components.description: An enamel station sign in the line's colour with a white inner border and ink outline.
components.css: .ds-board { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 12px 4px; background: #1e5b3c; color: #fff; border: 3px solid #fff; outline: 2px solid #17211d; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 18px 'Gill Sans', 'Gill Sans MT', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .01em; }

components.name: Timetable row
components.description: A train: describer berth, destination and calls, what it is doing, and its due time.
components.html: 1Eto Hartfield, calls at Pant GlasAt signal 206:24due
components.css: .ds-tr { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; background: #eef0ea; border-radius: 5px; padding: 5px 8px; font: 600 13.5px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #17211d; } .ds-hc { font: 700 15px Consolas, Menlo, monospace; background: #101412; color: #f2a33a; border-radius: 3px; text-align: center; } .ds-to small, .ds-tm small { display: block; font-weight: 400; font-size: 12px; color: #4d5a55; } .ds-tm { font: 13px Consolas, Menlo, monospace; text-align: right; }

narrative.overview: Signal Box is the inside of a railway signal box: an enamel track diagram on the wall, a painted lever frame on the floor, and trains shown as amber train describer berths.
keyCharacteristics: Enamel diagram in ink with red semaphore arms
One painted lever per job, with brass plates
White core for a road that is set

rules.name: A colour is a job
rules.body: Red for signals, black for points, blue for direction, amber for trains and time.

rules.name: Route set is white light
rules.body: A signalled or held road shows a white core down the track.

rules.name: Flat enamel
rules.body: Only the enamel plate casts a shadow; panels are ink rules.

dos: Keep every colour to its job
Explain every locked lever in one sentence
Write times as a working timetable does
donts: No neon route lines or glows
